name: Mirefin Head
summary: A Mirefin Head is a fishy meal sought by Mudcrush Durtfeet in northern Dustwallow Marsh. The ogre asks you to bring him food, and he favors murloc heads.

sections.title: Mudcrush's Meal
sections.body: Mudcrush Durtfeet in northern Dustwallow Marsh wants Mirefin Heads for food. He calls the murlocs “fishy” and warns you to bring him a meal, or he will eat you. Bring him eight heads, and he is pleased enough to spare you.

faq.answer: Mudcrush Durtfeet, an ogre in northern Dustwallow Marsh, wants Mirefin Heads for food.
Mudcrush is hungry and wants the heads as a meal. He says he likes the fishy taste.

faq.q: Where do Mirefin Heads come from?
faq.answer: Mirefin Heads come from murlocs in Dustwallow Marsh, including Mirefin Murlocs, Coastrunners, and Warriors.

faq.q: How many heads does Mudcrush need?
faq.answer: Mudcrush Durtfeet asks for eight Mirefin Heads.
